name: Open Banking Access
description: Read accounts, balances and transactions from open-banking.io, including Spanish banks. Refresh connected accounts with server-side decryption. Connect banks and renew consent in the provider app first. Account data only; no payment initiation.

credential_fields.name: api_base_url
credential_fields.label: API Base URL (optional override)
credential_fields.description: Defaults to https://open-banking.io. Change only if your provider credentials bundle specifies a different apiBaseUrl. This is not your Apteva server URL.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: apiKey from the exported credentials bundle.

credential_fields.name: private_key
credential_fields.label: Encryption Private Key
credential_fields.description: encryptionKey.privateKey from credentials.json: base64 PKCS#8 P-256 private key. Kept server-side for local decryption; never sent to the provider.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List accounts with decrypted identities and balances. needsReconnect indicates expired consent.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Read a page of decrypted transactions; amounts remain decimal strings.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List bank connections, consent expiry and live status.

tools.name: sync_account
tools.description: Refresh one account using its locally decrypted session identifier. Reconnect expired consent in the provider app. Background sync does not impersonate a present user.

tools.name: sync_all
tools.description: Refresh accounts with active sessions. Inspect failures for partial success, bank refusals or reconnect_needed. Does not initiate payments.
